states.narration: The coefficient one means one copy of the whole sum x+5. The second term contributes three more copies of that identical sum.
Collect the counts as one plus three. The one counts the entire group, so neither x nor the five inside its parentheses changes.
One plus three gives four copies of x+5. Only the count is evaluated; the group still contains x plus five.

editorial.title: One copy is still a whole group
editorial.setup: Read the first term as one copy of x+5, then find the matching group in the second term. Keep the copy counts separate from the numbers inside the group.
editorial.summary: Multiplying a group by one preserves the whole group. Combining one copy with three copies gives four copies of the same x+5, without finding the value of that variable sum.
